archived_representation.imputation: train median + missingness indicators; keep empty features

plan.calibration: none for candidates; probabilities are uncalibrated logistic/forest scores
plan.selection: maximum validation recall at FPR <=2%; precision then candidate name break ties
plan.holdout_policy: Previously examined historical holdouts are reused descriptively only. No tuning on holdout.

limitations: Both historical holdouts have previously been inspected. This is descriptive reuse, not independent confirmation or a production promotion claim.
No new external dataset or independently adjudicated live outcomes were collected; the study never fetches targets.
PhreshPhish scope is phishing only; archived ScamFerret remains isolated store/investment/crypto research.

Thresholds and candidate selection share validation; validation estimates are optimistic. Candidates use uncalibrated scores, while baseline used validation sigmoid calibration; Brier scores are not a fair calibration improvement comparison.

Wilson intervals treat rows as independent and are descriptive. Paired bootstrap clusters connected domains/campaigns but does not capture cross-domain unknown campaigns, source drift or tuning uncertainty.
Archived missingness can reflect upstream acquisition choices; imputation does not establish historical capture times or remove source/label bias.
Sensitivity thresholds are all fixed from validation, and their holdout results cannot be used to choose a production threshold.
Richer URL representation requires a new deployment format and independent confirmation; existing production bundle/schema/promotion eligibility are unchanged.

conclusions.phreshphish: The validation-selected character-plus-lexical candidate improves descriptive recall and precision on the identical historical holdout. Its train/validation gap remains large, its global FPR interval includes 2%, and HTTP legitimate false positives remain severe. This supports richer URL representation as a research direction, not production eligibility or confirmed live-site improvement.
conclusions.scamferret: Missingness-aware capacity restriction reduces descriptive false positives but loses recall, fails the 2% holdout FPR budget, and retains cryptocurrency false positives. It does not establish an overall model improvement. Archived acquisition/label biases and unknown capture times remain unresolved.
conclusions.next_confirmation_required: Freeze candidate, representation, global threshold and HTTP/crypto acceptance cohorts before collecting a new independently adjudicated domain-disjoint, later-period confirmation set; preserve source and label independence. Do not select among sensitivity thresholds using these holdout results.
conclusions.production_decision: Retain existing production bundle and research-only archived scam scope. No deployment-format, schema, allowlist or promotion changes are made.
